name: PDP Product List Manager for WooCommerce
author: promodiscounts

sections.description:
Sometimes, store owners need to display a specific group of products — but default category pages or shop pages simply don’t allow that.

Product List Manager solves this problem. With this plugin, you can create fully customizable product lists and place them anywhere on your site using a simple shortcode.

This is ideal for:

  • Black Friday or seasonal campaigns
  • “Last Items” or clearance sections
  • Focused product promotions
  • Highlighting bestsellers or new arrivals
  • Any custom group of products you want to emphasize

You decide what appears in each list — select products, categories, tags, or a mix.

Main Features:

  • Create unlimited product lists
  • Filter by products, categories, or product tags
  • Optionally exclude products or categories
  • Display lists anywhere using a shortcode
  • Control layout, columns, and sorting
  • Simple and fast interface for managing lists
  • Compatible with WooCommerce

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/product-list-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to “Product Lists Manager” in the WordPress admin menu to create your product lists.
  4. Use the [plm-product-list id="123"] shortcode to display a product list anywhere. Replace 123 with your list ID.
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is designed specifically for WooCommerce stores.

Can I exclude certain products or categories?

Yes, you can set both inclusion and exclusion rules for each product list.

How do I display a list on a page?

After creating a list, copy the shortcode provided and paste it into any post, page, or widget area.
